verdict.rationale: The API's core interaction model is natural-language prompting (gpt-docs-1), and it extends to agentic operation via function calling/tool use where the model interprets NL instructions to drive external systems and multi-step tasks (gpt-docs-7, gpt-docs-18, gpt-docs-27, gpt-docs-19). Community evidence corroborates real-world NL-driven agentic use via Codex (gpt-comm-2, gpt-comm-3, gpt-comm-5). Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of NL-command reliability/accuracy specifically (vs. general agent quality commentary), and documentation of NL-driven administrative/config operations beyond model interaction.
